# Solaris Gulch (LV-747)
[italic]Date 2181 - Solaris Gulch, UA controlled.[/italic]
[bold]Solaris Gulch[/bold], nicknamed [bold]"Big Red"[/bold], is a small desert settlement and failed terraforming project on a backwater world at the far end of the Neroid Sector. It now serves [textlink="Weyland-Yutani" link="CMUGuideLoreWY"] as a biological storage depot.
## History - The planet was first catalogued by the Kepler surveys in 2026, but its distance and remote position in the Neroid Sector made early colonization all but impossible. Its surface rights were eventually bought cheaply by a private company in 2135. - Terraforming began in 2125 using [bold]lichen[/bold], marketed as a cheaper alternative to atmosphere processors but never proven. The first two imported batches took hold, but the batches grown in the colony's own labs failed to thrive. - Recurring dust storms and an ever-growing repair bill drained the budget, and by 2144 the money had run out. - In 2145 the colonial director quietly sold the colony to Weyland-Yutani. Its two lichen labs, [bold]Eta[/bold] and [bold]Lambda[/bold], were converted into storage and study units for biological samples.
## Today - Around 120 colonists remain, all of them employed by the Company, willingly or not. Most off-worlders see it as a dead end. - It officially operates as a biological storage facility and virology lab, though rumor says even those have been shut down. The Company pays for upkeep and nothing more. - Its star is a dying orange giant, far brighter than Sol, and the dust storms still roll across the colony. Its buildings keep their storm shutters for a reason.
